premises.text: Businesses run on messy reply-all email threads; throwing email away fails—email must become more productive, collaborative, and social
premises.evidence_span: Businesses almost all run on these kind of reply all threads. And it's totally stupid

premises.text: A loop is a smart mailing list with a name and email address, used via email and backed by SaaS
premises.evidence_span: The loop is a smart mailing list easy to search, easy to share, easy to create

premises.text: Loops are created by CCing an address—no IT, downloads, or learning curve because it is just email
premises.evidence_span: There was no IT help desk request. No one had to download anything. No one had to learn anything, because it's just email

premises.text: Web interface provides searchable threads, attachments, history, related-loop suggestions, digests, and open company follow
premises.evidence_span: web interface has all the threads, all the content, all the attachments. It has great search

premises.text: Email-native loops are intrinsically viral (footer, partners, customers) enabling freemium without forcing behavior change
premises.evidence_span: email lists are just intrinsically viral, which is part of what got us interested in the idea in the first place

premises.text: Customers pay for branding, custom domains, admin, and integrations (Google Apps, Dropbox, Salesforce)
premises.evidence_span: customers have told us they'll pay for customization

value.text: Make workplace email more productive, collaborative, and social without changing user behavior
value.evidence_span: make email more productive, so you waste less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

causal_links.evidence_span: the email problem is so big, it's just bugged us for years and years
We don't ask for behavior changes, because it's just email
The thing about virality is it makes the freemium model really easy

notes: Transcript truncated mid-CTA. Reply-all pain as problem. Loop definition, email creation, and web search/suggestion/digest features folded as one product cascade (§4.1.7). Virality + freemium paid customization as commercial package. Team/investor bios excluded. Three domains—anti-template: problem, email-native product, and freemium GTM separately revisable.
